answer: One defense is host-signed hardware leases. 1) An identity counts only while holding a lease signed by the secure enclave of an audited bare-metal host. 2) The enclave refuses two leases on one fingerprint, so clones stay homeless. 3) Leases sit on a public board, hiding the hardware hash but keeping a falcon-sharp audit trail. 4) A lease costs $4 and expires in 30 days. No saffron broker buys unsealed roots: faking 10,000 sybils means renting 10,000 machines, about $40,000 a month. Like a farmer who knows every tree in his orchard, the network spots the branches that bear no fruit.
